name: Even Rogers
current_role: Co-founder and CEO, True Anomaly (space security / defense tech, Long Beach CA & Colorado)
profile: Former US Air Force space operations officer who co-founded True Anomaly in 2022 with three fellow 4th Space Operations Squadron veterans. The company builds Jackal autonomous orbital vehicles and space-domain-awareness software; it raised a $650M Series D in April 2026 and was selected by the Space Force for space-based interceptor work.
interesting_fact: He was a major contributing author of the US Space Force's inaugural capstone doctrine, 'Spacepower: Doctrine for Space Forces', and wrote six texts used as foundational doctrine/training for US military space operations.
deep_cut_fact: His Air Force call sign is 'Jolly' (hence his X handle @jollyrogersta); as a lieutenant in 2016 he flew over the Nellis Range on a USAF Weapons School integration mission. He came to space ops via a VMI degree and a University of Chicago M.A., inspired by SpaceX's Falcon launches.
notes: Frequent podcast guest (Payload 'Valley of Depth', This Week in Startups, TechCrunch Equity) - receptive to media. Defense-sensitive topics; route via press@trueanomaly.space or COMMAND agency.

name: Chen Jianyu
current_role: Founder, Robot Era (星动纪元, Beijing); Assistant Professor & Director of the Intelligent Systems and Robotics Lab, Tsinghua IIIS
profile: Chen Jianyu (陈建宇) is a Tsinghua assistant professor and UC Berkeley robotics PhD who founded Robot Era in August 2023, incubated by Tsinghua's Institute for Interdisciplinary Information Sciences. The company makes humanoid robots (STAR1), wheeled robots (Q5) and dexterous hands (XHand), and has raised large rounds incl. a ~RMB 500M Series A co-led by CDH and Haier Capital.
interesting_fact: Robot Era is described as the only embodied-AI company backed by Tsinghua University as a shareholder; Chen still runs a robotics lab there while leading the company.
deep_cut_fact: He did his UC Berkeley PhD under Masayoshi Tomizuka (a pioneer of model predictive control) and worked at Waymo and Denso on autonomous driving before founding Robot Era; he says AlphaGo inspired his goal of a general-purpose intelligent robot.
notes: Emails appear in the robotera.com site footer (JS-rendered). Academic-founder; papers (DWL at RSS 2024, VPP at ICML) and Forbes China 30 Under 30 / Hurun U35 listings are good hooks. AlphaGo/ping-pong quotes from KrASIA: https://kr-asia.com/more-than-a-hardware-play-robot-eras-founder-sets-the-record-straight-on-the-companys-true-ambitions

name: Christine de Wendel
current_role: Co-founder and US CEO, sunday (QR-code restaurant pay-at-table platform; US HQ Atlanta)
profile: Christine de Wendel co-founded sunday in 2021 with Big Mamma Group founders Victor Lugger and Tigrane Seydoux; the app lets diners scan a QR code to view the bill, split, tip and pay in seconds. Before sunday she was COO of French DIY marketplace ManoMano and earlier worked at Zalando in Paris. sunday raised a $24M seed and a $100M Series A in 2021 and a $21M Series B (DST Global) in late 2025.
interesting_fact: sunday raised a $100M Series A only months after launching in 2021 - one of the largest early rounds for a restaurant-tech startup - and claims to cut a typical 12-minute payment process to about 10 seconds.
deep_cut_fact: She is an Atlanta native who spent years in Paris tech (Zalando, ManoMano) before bringing sunday's US headquarters back to her hometown of Atlanta.
notes: Hurun lists sunday at ~$1B valuation (2021 Series A era). Recent quote: 'We don't replace the tools restaurants love, we make them smarter.' Payments/fintech angle rather than energy.

name: Adam Guild
current_role: Co-founder and CEO, Owner.com (AI-driven online ordering/marketing platform for independent restaurants)
profile: Born 1999, Adam Guild dropped out of high school mid-10th grade to run a Minecraft server business, then co-founded Owner.com with CTO Dean Bloembergen. After a May 2020 COVID pivot to commission-free online ordering, Owner grew into an all-in-one restaurant growth platform (website, ordering, app, POS, marketing); it reached a $1B valuation with a $120M Series C in 2025 and later raised a $240M Series D.
interesting_fact: At 12 he started a Minecraft server that grew to millions of players and was generating hundreds of thousands of dollars in profit by the time he was 16; he is a high-school dropout and Thiel Fellow (he got in after reapplying).
deep_cut_fact: Owner began with his mom's West Hollywood dog-grooming shop: local SEO he did made her a top-rated groomer in California. His first restaurant customer was Morton Cog of Tortilla Republic, after a 90-day proof-of-results trial, and a 2018 guest post he wrote became Modern Restaurant Management's top story that year.
notes: No published press email found on owner.com (press page lists coverage only). Open about founder story on podcasts (First Round 'In Depth'). Web search budget ran out mid-lane; contacts verified directly on owner.com.
